purpose: Genotype-only source-role overlap audit and candidate partition; not label admission or model training
timing: After verified whole-genome grouping and metadata-only role inspection; before any model fitting or evaluation results
rule: Remove primarytarget/near-seed components first. Keep all remaining published testing phages together as the candidate holdout. Quarantine every published training phage in any holdout-containing group. Mutants remain nontraining bridge records. No relabeling, random fallback, outcome-based subgroup choice or dropping a testing phage to improve metrics.
